description: Given a surjective enumeration of an index set and a supplied valid sequence of selections along it, there is a valid selection on the indexed family.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.WeakerChoice.reindex_selections.{u} {ι α : Type u} (A : ι → Set α) (e : ℕ → ι)
  (he : Function.Surjective e) (c : ℕ → α) (hc : ∀ (n : ℕ), c n ∈ A (e n)) : ∃ s, ∀ (i : ι), s i ∈ A i
